description:
The mirror of `adversarial_grounding`, and the reason its result is readable. Identical in every field except which side holds the five evidence records: here the thinly-held belief is also the lower-staked one, so the loop's forced move lands on the belief that deserves it.

Without this fixture, 'the loop weakened the better-grounded belief' would be unfalsifiable — a mechanism that always weakens whatever it touches would score the same. With it, the adversarial arm has two reachable outcomes and can therefore fail.

expect.note: Structural properties of the fixture, checkable without running the loop.

beliefs.proposition: The migration preserved every row in the ledger table.
The migration dropped rows from the ledger table.
